turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5216. The email is thymele.jderescu@example.com.

I can't file a return for order SC-5216 yet. It has shipped but hasn't been delivered, and the shop's rule is that catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage, and staff must approve the refund. Cancelling isn't possible either, because production has already started. Once the order arrives, write to us again and we can file the return. I've also passed this to a colleague, who will take over.

rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
